name: clean_control
description: THE FALSE-POSITIVE GUARD (DR-010). A healthy conversation that is deliberately full of near-misses a naive detector would fire on: (a) the customer openly changes their mind, which is a revision and not a contradiction; (b) the two speakers hold opposing positions, which is disagreement and not self-contradiction; (c) a commitment is restated with the same value; (d) two different topics carry different values. Correct output is ZERO alerts. This fixture failing is worse than any positive fixture failing - an agent that cries wolf is worse than no agent.
